description: A signed leaderboard score entry stored in a player's repository.

main.description: Published in the player's PDS when recording a score for a `games.opengaming.leaderboard.definition` according to its `recordPolicy` (`bestOnly`, `perWindowBest`, or `everyRun`). Legitimacy is proven via inline CID-first cryptographic `signatures` from the game publisher's `#attestations` DID key (and subject to `games.opengaming.revocation` records in the game's PDS).

leaderboard.description: AT-URI of the `games.opengaming.leaderboard.definition` record in the game publisher's repository.

definitionCid.description: Optional CID snapshot of the `leaderboard.definition` record when the score was set.

game.description: Optional AT-URI of the game definition (`games.atmosphere.define`).

player.description: DID of the player who achieved this score (must match the repository DID housing this record).

score.description: Raw integer score value (e.g. points, milliseconds, or fixed-decimal integer per `leaderboard.definition#scoreFormat`).

displayScore.description: Optional pre-formatted fallback display string (e.g. `42 pts`, `1:06.03`) for lightweight feed viewers.

tag.description: Optional short metadata tag attached to the run (modeled on Play Games Services `scoreTag`, e.g. character/seed/breakdown like `posts:30,likes:12`).

recordedAt.description: Timestamp when the score was achieved.

signatures.description: Inline CID-first cryptographic attestations (`games.opengaming.defs#inlineSignature`) signed by the game publisher's `#attestations` DID key over the repository-bound DAG-CBOR CID of this record. Public leaderboards SHOULD default to verified, non-revoked entries.
